rationale: Computed baseline SAIDI/CAIDI/SAIFI from fault section data. Applied FCI restoration time reductions from deployed locations n2 and n4, taking maximum reduction per section and respecting 25-minute floor. SAIDI improved from 12.575 to 10.0525 min/customer/year. CAIDI improved from 87.86 to 70.24 min/interruption. SAIFI unchanged as FCI affects restoration time, not fault rate.
